events.text: I'll clear the engine and set up a work map on your table, with sample tasks you can move between teams.

spec.text: These are sample tasks. Pinch a task card and drop it on a different agent to reassign it.
bullets: Drop a task on an agent to move it

events.text: Your work map is on the table, using sample tasks. Pinch a task card and drop it on Marketing, Sales, Research or Ops to move it.
Research now owns the launch email and will check it against customer findings.

spec.text: Research now owns Draft launch email. Pinch another task card to reassign it.
bullets: Moved: Draft launch email to Research

notes: Live generated agent map (sample data label on the table). The task card "Draft launch email" is pinched with the emulated hand, carried to Research and released; the program emits task_moved and Halo replies and updates its panel.
